nameFl:
IPEDS 2025-26 Import Specifications: Fall Enrollment
Applies to: 4-year, degree-granting institutions
File type: Fixed Length/Positional (*.txt)
noteFL:
Formatting Guidelines:
Numeric fields should be right-justified using either leading zeros or spaces.
Character fields should be left-justified.

If a level (undergraduate or graduate) is not applicable to the institution, do not include it in the import file. For example, if graduate programs are not offered at the institution, do not include a record for graduate level data in the import file.
nameKv:
IPEDS 2025-26 Import Specifications: Fall Enrollment
Applies to: 4-year, degree-granting institutions
File type: File type: Key Value Pair File (*.TXT)
noteKv:
Note: If there is zero enrollment for any category (e.g. student level, age, state), the line does not have to be included in the import file.

For Part C, HS=1 and 2 are not mutually exclusive categories. If first-time students enrolling within 12 months of graduating high school (HS=2) are reported for any state, also report those students in the total first-time students (HS=1) residency reporting.

Sort order: UNITID, SURVSECT, PART.
